description: This file defines the CurrentUserAccessor class, which implements ICurrentUserAccessor and provides a method to retrieve the current user's username based on HTTP context claims.

classes.name: CurrentUserAccessor
classes.description: Class responsible for accessing the current user's username via HTTP context claims.

methods.name: GetCurrentUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the username of the current user from the HTTP context claims, or null if not available.
